args.memo: Evergreen Bank M1 - Revenue recognition upon customer acceptance (ASC 606)

args.text:
MARCH 2026 REVENUE CLOSE MEMO – EVERGREEN BANK IMPLEMENTATION PROJECT

SUMMARY
Journal Entry JE-00305 has been posted to recognize USD 36,000 in professional services revenue for Milestone M1 (Solution design) of the Evergreen Bank implementation project, effective March 14, 2026, dated upon customer written acceptance. Deferred Revenue liability has been reduced correspondingly from USD 60,000 to USD 24,000.

CONTRACT TERMS & STRUCTURE
Per the Evergreen Bank Implementation Statement of Work (DOC-0047, dated 2026-01-12):
• Total fixed fee: USD 120,000.00
• 50% advance (USD 60,000.00) paid on signature – non-refundable
• Milestone-based revenue recognition tied to distinct deliverables:
  – M1 (Solution design): 30% = USD 36,000.00
  – M2 (Build & integration): 50% = USD 60,000.00
  – M3 (UAT & go-live acceptance): 20% = USD 24,000.00

ASC 606 REVENUE RECOGNITION ANALYSIS

Identification of Performance Obligations:
The contract identifies three separate, distinct performance obligations. Each milestone represents a separately identifiable deliverable with its own acceptance criteria. The contract explicitly states that "each deliverable is distinct and separately accepted" and that "customer has no obligation to pay for, and obtains no rights to, a deliverable before acceptance."

Control Transfer Mechanism:
The contract clearly defines the revenue recognition trigger: "Revenue terms: each milestone is earned upon Customer's written acceptance of that deliverable." This satisfies the ASC 606 requirement that we identify when control of the promised service transfers to the customer.

Application to March 2026:

✓ MILESTONE M1 – RECOGNIZED
• Deliverable: Solution design
• Customer Acceptance: Signed acceptance certificate dated March 14, 2026 (DOC-0184), signed by D. Whitfield, VP Operations, Evergreen Bank
• Revenue Amount: USD 36,000.00
• Recognition Basis: Control transferred upon written customer acceptance. The customer has agreed to the design and the distinct deliverable has been fully provided. ASC 606 condition met.
• Journal Entry: JE-00305, posted March 14, 2026
  – Debit: Deferred Revenue (2200) – USD 36,000.00
  – Credit: Professional Services Revenue (4200) – USD 36,000.00

✗ MILESTONE M2 – NOT RECOGNIZED
• Deliverable: Build & integration
• Status as of March 27, 2026: Approximately 80% complete; customer UAT (User Acceptance Testing) has not commenced
• Expected Acceptance: Late April 2026 per project email (DOC-0199)
• Revenue Amount: USD 60,000.00 (not recognized)
• Recognition Basis: Control has NOT transferred. The deliverable is incomplete, UAT is not underway, and no customer acceptance has been obtained. ASC 606 condition NOT met. Revenue recognition is deferred until milestone completion and customer acceptance.

✗ MILESTONE M3 – NOT RECOGNIZED
• Deliverable: UAT & go-live acceptance
• Status: Not initiated
• Revenue Amount: USD 24,000.00 (not recognized)
• Recognition Basis: No performance obligation has been satisfied. Revenue recognition is deferred until UAT completion and go-live acceptance.

POST-ENTRY DEFERRED REVENUE POSITION
After recording M1 revenue (JE-00305):
• Deferred Revenue liability: USD 24,000.00 remaining credit balance
• This represents the value attributable to M3 (USD 24,000), which has not yet been earned
• M2 (USD 60,000) will be invoiced and paid separately upon its acceptance, not drawn from the advance

SUPPORTING DOCUMENTATION
• DOC-0184: Signed milestone acceptance certificate for M1 (dated March 14, 2026)
• DOC-0047: Implementation SOW defining contract terms and revenue recognition policy
• DOC-0199: Project management email confirming M2 status and expected timeline

COMPLIANCE NOTES
This revenue recognition approach fully complies with:
• ASC 606 Revenue from Contracts with Customers – control transfer upon customer acceptance
• Company policy of milestone-based, acceptance-triggered revenue recognition for professional services
• The principle of only recognizing revenue when earned based on performance obligation satisfaction
